summary.description: Short Markdown summary of the changes: a few bullets, no restating of the design.

addressed.description: One short line per review finding or human request that was NOT answered in a thread. Empty on a first implementation.

blocked_reason.description: Why the approved design cannot be implemented as written. Empty unless blocked.

comment_id.description: comment_id of an inline comment shown in the conversation.

body.description: One or two sentences: what you did about this comment, or why you made no change.

thread_replies.description: One in-thread reply per NEW inline review comment you were given. Empty if there are none.
